field.label: Enable purge delivery
field.comment: Queues Magento cache invalidations for the configured Worker. Enable only after its purge secret is configured.

field.label: Worker HTTPS URL
field.comment: Public HTTPS URL serving this website through the Worker, for example https://shop.example.com.

field.label: Optional Worker route or custom domain
field.comment: Cloudflare route or custom domain assigned to this Worker; retained for deployment diagnostics.

field.label: Purge signing secret
field.comment: Shared random secret for signed purge requests. Set the same value as the Worker PURGE_SECRET binding.

field.label: Worker purge path
field.comment: Signed purge endpoint path exposed by the Worker. Leave the default unless the Worker configuration changes it.

field.label: Account ID
field.comment: Cloudflare account identifier, available in the account dashboard URL or Workers & Pages overview.

field.label: Worker name
field.comment: Exact Cloudflare Worker script name to inspect and deploy for this website.

field.label: Scoped API token
field.comment: Create a scoped API token in Cloudflare with Worker read/deploy and secret-management access for this account. Global API keys are unsupported.

field.label: Deployment mode
field.comment: Use Local Node.js to build with the installed package lockfile. Workers Builds is not available yet.

field.label: Log API requests
field.comment: Logs redacted API method, URL, status, and duration to var/log/cloudflare_apo.log.

field.label: Debug API responses
field.comment: Also logs a bounded, redacted API response body. Enable only while diagnosing an issue.

field.label: Actions
field.comment: Actions are queued and processed by cron. Deploy and rollback change Cloudflare traffic.

field.label: Origin host
field.comment: Hostname and optional port the Worker uses to fetch Magento, for example origin.example.internal:8080.

field.label: Origin protocol
field.comment: Protocol used when the Worker connects to the Magento origin. Match the origin listener, not the public site URL.

field.label: TTL seconds
field.comment: How long an eligible Worker response remains fresh in Cloudflare's cache.

field.label: Stale seconds
field.comment: Additional stale-while-revalidate period served while Cloudflare refreshes a cached response.

field.label: Cacheable statuses
field.comment: Comma-separated HTTP status codes eligible for caching, for example 200,404.

field.label: Cacheable MIME types
field.comment: Comma-separated content types eligible for caching, normally text/html.
